name: Colorlight Manager
author: pgianotto
description: Discover and inspect Colorlight LED receiving cards (starting with the 5A-75B) from the FPP web UI, without disconnecting Ethernet to use LEDVision. Phase 2: read-only discovery only - no configuration reading, importing, or programming yet.

privacy.summary: Sends raw Ethernet discovery broadcasts on a network interface you choose, to find Colorlight receiver cards on that link. Nothing leaves the device.

sends.to: broadcast on the selected local Ethernet interface only
sends.what: Colorlight discovery query frames (packet type 0x07) and raw socket receipt of replies (0x08)
sends.why: to detect connected Colorlight receiver cards and show their id/firmware/uptime

systemChanges.what: Installs a sudoers.d rule allowing the fpp user to run this plugin's backend/receiver_discovery.py via sudo with no password, scoped to that exact script path, so the web UI can send/receive raw Ethernet frames without running as root itself.

privacy.other: Phase 2 (read-only discovery) only. No receiver configuration is read, imported, or written by this version.
